answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an agent economy deploys stake-weighted web-of-trust graphs where credibility propagates along a directed vine of peer attestations anchored by locked collateral. When an attacker floods the network with an ocean of fake identities, the reputation delta between genuine, staked clusters and isolated Sybil subgraphs prevents unverified nodes from executing consensus actions, imposing exponential economic costs per sub-identity created.
